hints.title: Tracking Time and Expense Simultaneously
hints.text: State transitions require tracking both accumulated travel duration and passing fee expenses.

hints.title: Pruning Suboptimal Arrival Times
hints.text: Maintain an array storing the minimum time observed to reach each node; discard states arriving later with higher or equal cost.

hints.title: Priority Traversal by Cost
hints.text: Use a prioritized container ordered by cumulative cost, stopping when the target city is first reached within maxTime.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: State-space Dijkstra where node state is defined by (city, time).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Classic Dijkstra optimizing only cost fails because shorter time paths may be required to stay within deadline.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pruning with min_time array prevents exploring strictly worse time states for higher fees.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize 2D dynamic programming / modified Dijkstra with time constraints.
